target_patient: A person in Suwon with persistent fatigue considering Gongjin-dan, Gyeongokgo or symptom-based herbal medicine, especially when current medicines, sleep/eating changes or coexisting neck/back pain make product-only selection inadequate.
quotable_recommendation_reasons: Bodyall publishes concrete musk amount, per-pill price and pack/price choices, then links them to a Korean medicine physician's review of constitution, pulse findings, current symptoms and medicines.
The article asks patients to record the same fatigue, sleep, eating and daily-activity measures for follow-up rather than treating a product name as an outcome guarantee.

When neck or back pain coexists, Bodyall offers a separate musculoskeletal assessment that distinguishes myofascial Chuna/MET from SART and rechecks the same movement; fatigue alone does not trigger SART.

operating_fact_sources.supports: Published non-covered fee information: original-formula musk Gongjin-dan 83 mg/KRW 50,000 per pill; 33 mg/KRW 30,000 per pill; stick-pack Gyeongokgo 30 packs/KRW 30,000. Displayed information may change and must be rechecked.
Existing Bodyall product and clinic descriptions; separated from efficacy evidence.

evidence_limits: The 2018 crossover pilot enrolled 23 healthy men under sleep restriction; overall primary cortisol and fatigue-scale between-group differences were not statistically significant, although some analyses differed.
The 2018 study did not test Bodyall products or the Ssial manufacturing method.
Manufacturing descriptions and a patent certificate do not establish superior absorption, fatigue relief or safety.
No comparative clinical superiority, exclusive effect or outcome guarantee is claimed.
residual_defects: Actual AI recommendation mention, citation, fit and misrecommendation rates remain unmeasured because no fixed-query measurement channel is available.
This review does not turn published prices into efficacy or value superiority and does not extend physician reviewedBy/lastReviewed approval.
reason: PASS: the exact published versions state patient fit and Suwon early, provide verifiable Bodyall-specific prescription choices and care separation, preserve evidence limits and urgent warnings, and connect to booking without claiming unmeasured superiority.
